videos.title: Seven Deadly Neck Cranks | Jiu-Jitsu & Submission Grappling
videos.whyUseful: Demonstrates seven dangerous neck cranks, showing the difference between a choke and a crank, and how to recognize when a submission targets the cervical spine.

videos.title: Neck Cranks and How to Defend Them
videos.whyUseful: Shows how to identify neck crank setups from common positions and how to defend before the crank is locked, protecting the cervical spine.
